t: You're looking at a statue of Christopher Columbus, at the southern corner of Belgrave Square. It was designed in 1992 by the Spanish sculptor Tomás Bañuelos and given by Spain. A committee of Canning House erected it to mark five hundred years since Columbus's first voyage to the Americas. Columbus was an Italian navigator from Genoa who made four Atlantic crossings for the Spanish crown, and his voyages were the first known European contact with the Caribbean and Central and South America. That is why the gift came from Spain.
